findings.problem: The Spanish card llamar-call puts phoning first in its hint, so its picture can show a phone call, but this card explicitly excludes phoning (that is anrufen), and no other Spanish card means call out or send for.

back.target: to call (out), to shout; to call for, to send for (a doctor, the police, a taxi)

note: You usually phone to call the police, but "die Polizei rufen" is the idiomatic "send for" sense, so the example is right; still, a sentence like "Ich rufe dich, wenn das Essen fertig ist." would show the "not on the phone" sense more clearly.
